name: The End of an Actress
source:
A tragic love story about a feckless queen and an impoverished revolutionary, based on the life (and death) of Marie Antoinette.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一段关于无能女王与贫困革命者的悲剧爱情故事，取材于玛丽·安托瓦内特的一生与死亡。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147760/]Steam[/url]]
